description: List the undo and redo stacks: tool name, args summary, files affected, and age in seconds for each entry. Use to decide how far to undo (then call mcp_undo with the chosen count) or to confirm a specific change is still on the stack. Returns {undo: [...newest-first], redo: [...newest-first], cap: {entries, max_entries, bytes, max_bytes}}.

limit.description: Max entries to return per stack. Defaults to 20.

name: mcp_undo_history
